Based on the web search results, I found relevant information about NVIDIA's agent harness and related open-source resources:

## Key Findings:

### NeMo Agent Toolkit
The NVIDIA NeMo Agent toolkit is an open-source library for efficiently connecting and optimizing teams of AI agents. The toolkit includes several performance optimization features. There is an improved, standalone evaluation harness and migration to ATIF for trajectory format.

### NOOA - Object Oriented Agents
NVIDIA-labs Object Oriented Agents (NOOA) is a model-agnostic Python framework designed to support reliable AI agent development and offers an alternative object-oriented interface. The project includes resources on agent capabilities - a blog post on "Six Agent Harness Capabilities for Higher Model Performance."

### Nemotron Models for Agentic AI
A training recipe for NVIDIA's largest Nemotron 3 model — a 550B-A55B hybrid Mamba-Attention Mixture-of-Experts Transformer with LatentMoE and multi-token prediction (MTP), pretrained in NVFP4 and extended to 1M-token context for datacenter-scale agentic reasoning.

All of these projects are available on GitHub under NVIDIA's repositories (NVIDIA-NeMo, NVIDIA/NeMo-Agent-Toolkit, and NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-OO-Agents) as open-source initiatives for building and optimizing AI agents with Nemotron models.
